Introduction to Postiz-Cheap

Postiz-cheap is an independent, open-source social media management and scheduling application designed for creators who want total control over their infrastructure. Licensed under the MIT License, the software provides a self-hostable alternative for planning, composing, and publishing content across multiple connected platforms.

Core Features and Capabilities

  • Shared Content Calendar: Review scheduled, processing, published, and failed posts in a unified interface. Create new entries directly from calendar slots or modify existing posts.
  • Multi-Platform Composer: Select connected channels, attach media, and adjust platform-specific settings such as video options, tags, and privacy controls.
  • AI Writing and Assistant: Generate titles, captions, and tags using an integrated AI writer. Use the conversational workspace to brainstorm ideas and refine copy with contextual follow-up prompts.
  • Account Management: Connect accounts through supported provider authorization flows, rename connections, or disconnect platforms as needed.
  • Media Gallery: Review and download successfully published videos returned by connected channels.

Technical Architecture and Self-Hosting

The application is built using Next.js 16 App Router, React 19, Tailwind CSS, Framer Motion, and Prisma with a PostgreSQL database. Authentication relies on NextAuth with Google sign-in support.

Because this is a self-hosted repository rather than a managed service, users must provide their own infrastructure, database, and necessary external provider credentials. Real AI generation, account connections, and publishing require MuAPI keys, and usage charges from external providers may apply. Optional Stripe credit checkout integration is also available for configuration.

Verification and Official Resources

To review the source code, examine setup instructions, and verify deployment guidelines, consult the official Postiz-cheap GitHub Repository.
